", "arrow": "data:image/png;base64,", "smoke": "data:image/png;base64,", "skull": "data:image/png;base64,"};
const defs = [
 ['duration','ms'],['recoil','px'],['bowFall','px/s'],['bowSpin','deg/s'],['arrowFall','px/s'],['arrowSpin','deg/s'],
 ['burst','force'],['gravity','px/s²'],['smokeScale','%'],['smokeLinger','ms'],['skullRise','%']
];
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const canvas = $('c'), ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const imgs = {};
let playing=false, phase=0, last=0, ready=false;
function v(id){ return +$(id).value; }
function syncOutputs(){ defs.forEach(([id,unit])=>{ $(id+'Out').textContent = $(id).value + unit; }); }
defs.forEach(([id])=>$(id).addEventListener('input',()=>{syncOutputs(); render();}));
$('showIronbound').addEventListener('change',render); $('showRing').addEventListener('change',render);
$('reset').onclick=()=>{phase=0; playing=false; setState('Ready'); render();};
$('play').onclick=()=>{ if(phase>=1) phase=0; playing=!playing; setState(playing?'Playing':'Paused'); };
function setState(t){ $('state').textContent=t; $('play').textContent=playing?'Pause':'Play death'; }

const scene = typeof COMBAT_SCENE !== 'undefined' ? COMBAT_SCENE : {"width":460,"height":294,"pixelRatio":2,"iron":{"x":44,"y":98,"w":130,"h":182},"ironShadow":{"x":57,"y":268,"w":104,"h":24},"archer":{"x":320,"y":285,"h":134},"archerShadow":{"dx":-48,"dy":-13,"w":96,"h":23},"ring":{"dx":0,"dy":-6,"rx":30,"ry":7},"fade":{"y":256,"h":38}};
const unit=scene.pixelRatio;
const base = {x:scene.archer.x*unit,y:scene.archer.y*unit,h:scene.archer.h*unit};
// Hand-traced, non-overlapping anatomical regions in the original 700x642 sprite.
const archerPieces = [
 {name:'hood',poly:[[276,0],[527,0],[550,105],[475,183],[343,205],[275,150],[249,86]],vx:12,vy:-32,spin:36},
 {name:'bow arm',poly:[[100,175],[249,150],[275,150],[343,205],[298,261],[170,277],[100,245]],vx:-48,vy:0,spin:-45},
 {name:'quiver',poly:[[527,0],[700,0],[700,274],[548,274],[475,183],[550,105]],vx:40,vy:-12,spin:48},
 {name:'torso',poly:[[343,205],[475,183],[548,274],[700,274],[700,380],[511,423],[310,404],[235,343],[170,277],[298,261]],vx:4,vy:0,spin:22},
 {name:'front leg',poly:[[235,343],[310,404],[408,414],[383,642],[100,642],[100,277],[170,277]],vx:-35,vy:8,spin:-34},
 {name:'back leg',poly:[[408,414],[511,423],[700,380],[700,642],[383,642]],vx:32,vy:9,spin:42}
];
// Bow outline follows its outer curve; separate arrow uses its existing transparent asset.
const bowPoly=[[0,0],[276,0],[249,86],[249,150],[100,175],[100,245],[100,277],[100,642],[0,642]];
let pieces=[];
function makePieces(){
 const img=imgs.archer, W=img.width,H=img.height;
 // Assign each opaque pixel to only one mask, avoiding duplicated rectangular slices.
 const claimed=document.createElement('canvas');claimed.width=W;claimed.height=H;
 const cc=claimed.getContext('2d');
 for(const p of [{name:'bow',poly:bowPoly},...archerPieces]){
  const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=W;cv.height=H;const c=cv.getContext('2d');
  c.beginPath();p.poly.forEach(([x,y],i)=>i?c.lineTo(x*W/700,y*H/642):c.moveTo(x*W/700,y*H/642));c.closePath();c.save();c.clip();c.drawImage(img,0,0);c.restore();
  c.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';c.drawImage(claimed,0,0);c.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';cc.drawImage(cv,0,0);
  const data=c.getImageData(0,0,W,H).data;let l=W,r=0,t=H,b=0;
  for(let y=0;y<H;y++)for(let x=0;x<W;x++)if(data[(y*W+x)*4+3]>8){l=Math.min(l,x);r=Math.max(r,x);t=Math.min(t,y);b=Math.max(b,y)}
  if(r>l&&b>t)pieces.push({...p,img:cv,l,t,w:r-l+1,h:b-t+1});
 }
}
function drawPart(p,dx,dy,rot,alpha){
 const sc=base.h/imgs.archer.height, left=base.x-base.h*imgs.archer.width/imgs.archer.height/2,top=base.y-base.h;
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.translate(left+(p.l+p.w/2)*sc+dx,top+(p.t+p.h/2)*sc+dy);ctx.rotate(rot);
 ctx.drawImage(p.img,p.l,p.t,p.w,p.h,-p.w*sc/2,-p.h*sc/2,p.w*sc,p.h*sc);ctx.restore();
}
function easeOutCubic(t){ return 1-Math.pow(1-t,3); }
function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a, Math.min(b,x)); }
function lerp(a,b,t){ return a+(b-a)*t; }
function alphaPulse(a,b,t){ return a + (b-a)*(0.5-0.5*Math.cos(Math.PI*clamp(t,0,1))); }

function drawImg(name, x, y, w, h, rot=0, alpha=1){
  if(alpha<=0) return;
  const img = imgs[name];
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.drawImage(img, -w/2, -h, w, h);
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawClip(name, sx,sy,sw,sh, dx,dy,dw,dh, rot=0, alpha=1){
  if(alpha<=0) return;
  const img = imgs[name];
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
  ctx.translate(dx+dw/2,dy+dh/2);
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.drawImage(img, sx,sy,sw,sh, -dw/2,-dh/2, dw,dh);
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawShadow(x,y,w,h,alpha=1){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
  ctx.drawImage(imgs.shadow, x-w/2, y-h/2, w, h);
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawRing(x,y,rx,ry,alpha=1){
  if(!$('showRing').checked || alpha<=0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
  const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,rx);
  g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,220,140,0.02)');
  g.addColorStop(0.75,'rgba(255,198,80,0.16)');
  g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,198,80,0.7)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,216,120,'+alpha+')'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawImpactSpark(x,y,t){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  const a=(1-t);
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
    const ang=i*(Math.PI*2/10)+t*0.6;
    const len=18+t*38+(i%3)*8;
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,${190+i*4},80,${a*0.9})`;
    ctx.lineWidth= i%3===0 ? 3 : 1.6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x,y);
    ctx.lineTo(x+Math.cos(ang)*len,y+Math.sin(ang)*len*0.8);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  const r=20+t*26;
  const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);
  g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,245,220,${a})`); g.addColorStop(0.45,`rgba(255,150,70,${a*0.65})`); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,80,25,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}
const images={};const values={smokeSize:150,skullSize:150};
const ease=x=>{x=clamp(x,0,1);return x*x*(3-2*x)};
function smoke(x,y,t){if(t<=0||t>=1)return;const grow=ease(t/.34),fade=1-ease((t-.60)/.40),scale=values.smokeSize/100;ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(scale,scale);const a=images.smokeArt;const lift=22*ease(t);ctx.globalAlpha=fade*.8*grow;let stemW=29+15*grow,stemH=22+lift;ctx.drawImage(a,-stemW/2,-stemH,stemW,stemH);let w=28+88*grow,h=20+38*grow;ctx.globalAlpha=fade*grow;ctx.drawImage(a,-w/2,-h-lift,w,h);ctx.globalAlpha=fade*.66*grow;ctx.drawImage(a,-48*grow,-17,96*grow,23);ctx.restore()}
function skull(x,y,t){if(t<=0||t>=1)return;let a=images.skullArt,s=values.skullSize/100*(.78+.22*ease(t));ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y-43-66*ease(t));ctx.scale(s,s);ctx.globalAlpha=ease(t/.16)*(1-ease((t-.53)/.47));ctx.shadowBlur=5;ctx.shadowColor='#b6a5cf';ctx.drawImage(a,-28,-26,56,56*a.height/a.width);ctx.restore()}

function drawSmokeAndSkull(x,y,t){images.smokeArt=imgs.smoke;images.skullArt=imgs.skull;values.smokeSize=v('smokeScale');values.skullSize=v('skullRise');ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(unit,unit);smoke(0,0,t);skull(0,0,clamp((t-.22)/.78,0,1));ctx.restore();}

function render(){
  if(!ready) return;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  ctx.drawImage(imgs.bg,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  if($('showIronbound').checked){
    const sh=scene.ironShadow; drawShadow((sh.x+sh.w/2)*unit,(sh.y+sh.h/2)*unit,sh.w*unit,sh.h*unit,0.9);
    const ir=scene.iron; drawImg('iron',(ir.x+ir.w/2)*unit,(ir.y+ir.h)*unit,ir.w*unit,ir.h*unit);
  }
  const t = phase;
  const total = v('duration');
  const recoilEnd = 0.16;
  const shatterStart = 0.16;
  const smokeStart = 770/total;
  const fadeStart = (770+v("smokeLinger"))/total;
  const ringAlpha = t < smokeStart ? 0.92*(1-clamp((t-0.33)/0.2,0,1)) : 0;
  const ash=scene.archerShadow; drawShadow(base.x+(ash.dx+ash.w/2)*unit,base.y+(ash.dy+ash.h/2)*unit,ash.w*unit,ash.h*unit,t<smokeStart ? 0.78 : 0.22);
  const ring=scene.ring;
  if(t < shatterStart){
    const rt = clamp(t/recoilEnd,0,1);
    const recoil = rt < 1 ? Math.sin(rt*Math.PI)*v('recoil') : 0;
    const lift = rt < 1 ? -Math.sin(rt*Math.PI)*8 : 0;
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(-recoil,lift);
    drawImg('archer',base.x,base.y,base.h*imgs.archer.width/imgs.archer.height,base.h,-Math.sin(rt*Math.PI)*0.02);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  if(t >= shatterStart){
    const seconds=(t-shatterStart)*total/1000;
    const force=v('burst')/95, grav=v('gravity');
    const fx=clamp((t-smokeStart)*total/v("smokeLinger"),0,1); const alpha=1-ease(fx/.32);
    const gearAlpha=1-ease(fx/.55);
    for(const p of pieces){
      if(p.name==='bow'){
        drawPart(p,-22*seconds,Math.min(110,v('bowFall')*seconds+grav*seconds*seconds/2),-v('bowSpin')*seconds*Math.PI/180,gearAlpha);
      }else{
        const q=Math.min(seconds,0.65);
        drawPart(p,p.vx*force*q, p.vy*force*q+grav*q*q/2,p.spin*force*q*Math.PI/180,alpha);
      }
    }
    const sc=base.h/imgs.archer.height, aw=264*sc,ah=49*sc;
    const ax=base.x-45-45*seconds, ay=base.y-176+Math.min(165,v('arrowFall')*seconds+grav*seconds*seconds/2);
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=gearAlpha;ctx.translate(ax,ay);ctx.rotate(v('arrowSpin')*seconds*Math.PI/180);ctx.drawImage(imgs.arrow,-aw/2,-ah/2,aw,ah);ctx.restore();
  }
  if(t >= smokeStart){
    const st = clamp((t-smokeStart)*total/v("smokeLinger"),0,1);
    drawSmokeAndSkull(base.x-22*unit, base.y-13.5*unit, st);
  }
  ctx.drawImage(imgs.fg,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  ctx.drawImage(imgs.fade,0,scene.fade.y*unit,canvas.width,scene.fade.h*unit);
  drawRing(base.x+ring.dx*unit,base.y+ring.dy*unit,ring.rx*unit,ring.ry*unit,ringAlpha);
}
function tick(now){
  if(playing && last){
    phase += Math.min(now-last,60)/v('duration');
    if(phase>=1){ phase=1; playing=false; setState('Finished'); }
  }
  last = now;
  render();
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
Promise.all(Object.entries(sources).map(([k,src])=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ const img=new Image(); img.onload=()=>{imgs[k]=img; resolve();}; img.onerror=reject; img.src=src; }))).then(()=>{ makePieces(); ready=true; syncOutputs(); setState('Ready'); render(); requestAnimationFrame(tick); }).catch(()=>{ $('state').textContent='Asset load failed'; });
</script>
</body>
</html>
